children: The Polish budget deficit for 2027 is expected to reach 282.6 billion zlotys  ($75.88 billion), which is 11 billion zlotys more than planned for 2026, Wirtualna Polska and Money.pl reported on Friday.
They said that budget revenue was expected to reach 695 billion zlotys, and expenditures 977.6 billion zlotys.

The Polish government will debate the draft budget on Friday. Prime Minister Donald Tusk previously said that next year's budget priorities will include security, health, energy, rail, and road investments.
In June 2026, the government adopted a macroeconomic forecast for 2027, which assumes economic growth of 3.1% and average annual inflation of 2.5%.
